messages:
emma_cs: FYI — customer ACME support ticket reports users not getting trial credits from promo 'ACME-WELCOME'. They say code applied but credits not granted. Anyone seen this?

javier_support: Ticket 98321. Customer says code redeemed but balance unchanged. They attached screenshot of API response: 200 OK with {applied: true, credits: 0}

emma_cs: hmmm. I'll check campaign config. Can someone pull promo id 78?

raj_engineer: pulling now. found campaign 78 -> start_time: \"2026-11-01T00:00:00-08:00\" redemption_limit_per_account: 1 total_redemption_cap: 1000 status: active

olivia_pm: Wait start_time is Nov 1 PST — customer in UTC said it should start Nov 1 UTC. That could make it already active for them? not sure.

raj_engineer: The weird bit: created via admin UI, but timezone field was entered as \"-08:00\" accidentally instead of \"Z\". system treats start_time in stored UTC but UI allowed offsets. That makes start go earlier/later depending on user. For this customer, start_time calculated as 2026-11-01T08:00Z (8 hours later) — but they redeemed earlier? Hmm.

mike_billing: Also redemption_limit_per_account:1 — they thought it was unlimited per-account. If they tried to redeem multiple times only first should work. But they claim none worked.

javier_support: I pulled API logs — for their account id acme_user_01, redemption request 2026-10-31T23:50:11Z returned success:true but credits_granted:0 with reason:\"cap_reached\". total_redemptions was 1000 at the time. So global cap was already hit due to a batch import yesterday.

emma_cs: oh — batch import of legacy codes consumed global cap without updating customer mapping.

raj_engineer: repro steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/78/redeem -d '{"account_id":"acme_user_01","code":"ACME-WELCOME"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
2) Response: 200 {"success":true,"credits_granted":0,"reason":"cap_reached"}

raj_engineer: root cause: two mistakes
- start_time timezone entry ambiguous in UI leading to confusion about when promo should be live
- total_redemption_cap set too low and consumed by a bulk import script that didn't mark some redemptions as 'internal' preventing customer-facing grants

olivia_pm: Proposed fixes:
- immediate: temporarily increase total_redemption_cap to 2000 and run backfill to mark internal imports as internal so they don't count
- support: issue one-time compensation voucher to affected accounts
- long-term: validation on UI for timezone input (force Z or show normalized UTC) and add an 'exclude_from_cap' flag for internal imports

mike_billing: I'll approve comp voucher for the impacted list. Ticket 98321 -> billing actioned.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: promo-config-rollout at 1805001300 by @raj_engineer

raj_engineer: rolled cap to 2000 at 2026-10-31T23:55:20Z, running backfill now. Patch in UI to show normalized UTC will be in canary by EOD.

javier_support: Updated customer: credits granted retroactively, they confirmed +50 trial credits appeared. :tada: 

emma_cs: closing ticket once backfill completes. Thanks team. cc @olivia_pm @mike_billing :thumbsup:

olivia_pm: let's add a small docs blurb for account teams about timezone caveats when creating promos.

raj_engineer: note for postmortem: ensure import scripts set exclude_from_cap by default. I'll open PM-457.

javier_support: Ticket 98321 updated: status resolved. Closing thread.
